findings.title: Ledger post failure silently swallowed before gateway refund fires
findings.note: Any exception from ledger.post is caught and discarded: no log, no re-raise, no cause kept. Code then still calls gateway.refund, so money can move while the ledger has no record and nobody learns the write failed.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: except OSError at line 38 logs with log.exception (preserves traceback) and re-raises as RuntimeError with 'from exc', preserving the cause chain. This is a boundary conversion, not masking.
